correctness.rationale: On C_n^2, closed minority flips if and only if cut C does not decrease. The bond change identity C=n+Z-2J and four-site flip difference are algebraically verified. Adjacent bond-one annihilation yields a nondecreasing path to an independent set; connected hard-core slides and the five-zero 00000 -> 01100 -> 01010 move increase C whenever k<k_n. This proves every initial state has a path to a global optimum. Run bounds yield the complete exact maximum-cut count, explicit neutral lift loops join complementary spin words, and the zero-residue states are absorbing. All finite experiments check, but do not replace, the unbounded proof; original scripts from exact attached paths replay with the recorded outputs.

Pini and Rettori state approximate field-response results, not finite recurrent-class classification. Hence the full present theorem is not logically implied by the inspected prior statements.

originality.rationale: The 2010 full-text primary model article supplies cut-energy monotonicity and cycle/path/clique cases, but these do not classify nonbipartite four-regular squared cycles. The ANNNI chain at J1=2J2 under magnetization-conserving two-spin Kawasaki updates is not the equal-weight single-spin model; the 2007 weak-field response work is not an exact zero-temperature recurrent-class theorem. The closest same-graph deterministic open-neighborhood fixed-point census enumerates different events under a different map; its statement does not entail convergence of this Markov chain to max cuts or the class topology. Remaining unindexed prior-work risk is real.
residual_risks: Older exact finite-ring zero-temperature dynamical literature may exist under Ising, Kawasaki/Glauber or cellular-automaton terminology.

value.rationale: The core gap is to distinguish metastable zero-temperature trapping from global optimization on a frustrated 4-regular nonbipartite ring. A fully constructive guarantee that no nonoptimal closed classes exist, together with a four-residue bifurcation in absorbing/irreducible topology and exact recurrent populations, is nontrivial dynamical structure. This is not a mere independent-set enumeration: particle-pair creation, global reachability and complementary-spin monodromy are essential. No mixing-rate theorem is asserted.
